name: backlight
title: Backlight
description: An ambilight glow behind a picture or video, made from a blurred, over-saturated copy of the content itself, so the glow takes the picture's colours.

moworks.author: magicui

options.fadeIn: s to bring the glow up (0: always on)

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: Static upstream; the glow follows whatever plays inside (a HyperFrames video clip works). fadeIn is this port's option. Upstream demos: blur 5 (logos), 20 (photo), 40 (video).
moworks.titleVi: Quầng sáng lấy màu từ chính ảnh
